title: Reading Why: Born-Measured Attention with Exact Word Evidence on Light and Qubits
abstract: arXiv:2611.05355v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When a language model answers, we can usually only estimate why. We build a transformer in which every step is a Born measurement - attention $|\langle q|k\rangle|^4$ normalised over each row, a measured product in place of the feed-forward nonlinearity, and a Born readout. With its denominators held at their values for the input, each class probability is a polynomial in the word amplitudes, so its integrated-gradient evidence is computed by a finite quadrature with no quadrature error: the words' contributions sum to the class probability above its no-information share, to $10^{-11}$ or better. On e-SNLI natural language inference, with about 98k parameters outside the embedding, the model reaches $76.98 \pm 0.17$% test accuracy, level with a softmax transformer of the same size ($76.62 \pm 0.36$%). translated_title: 解读“为什么”：在光与量子比特上实现具有精确词证据的玻恩测量注意力机制
translated_abstract: 当语言模型给出答案时，我们通常只能估计其“为什么”。我们构建了一个变换器，其中每一步都是一次玻恩测量——注意力为在每一行上归一化的 $|\langle q|k\rangle|^4$，用测量乘积取代前馈非线性，并采用玻恩读出。将其分母保持在输入时的取值，每个类别概率都是词振幅的多项式，因此其积分梯度证据可以通过有限求积精确计算，不存在求积误差：各词的贡献之和恰好等于类别概率超出无信息份额的部分，误差达到 $10^{-11}$ 或更好。在 e-SNLI 自然语言推理任务上，该模型在嵌入层之外约 98k 参数的规模下达到 76.98 ± 0.17% 的测试准确率，与同规模的 softmax 变换器持平（76.62 ± 0.36%）。删除证据排名第一的词会在 45% 的测试样本对中改变答案，而这接近任何单个词删除所能改变答案的比例上限（53%）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种由玻恩测量构成的变换器（玻恩归一化注意力、测量乘积与玻恩读出），使类别概率成为词振幅的多项式，从而可通过有限求积无误差地精确计算每个词的积分梯度证据，并在 e-SNLI 上取得与同规模 softmax 变换器相当的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a transformer built entirely from Born measurements (row-normalized Born attention, a measured product in place of the feed-forward nonlinearity, and a Born readout), which makes each class probability a polynomial in word amplitudes so that exact integrated-gradient word evidence is obtained by finite quadrature with zero quadrature error, while matching the accuracy of a same-size softmax transformer on e-SNLI.
